turns.speaker: clinician

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: This looks like major depression. A single episode like to do is start sertraline. 25 milligrams once a day for one week, up to 50 milligrams once a day. It can take four to six weeks to really feel the difference.

turns.speaker: patient

turns.text: Some people get an uproar or a headache the first week or two, usually fade. Take it when because of your If you ever notice you're suddenly wired, not sleeping,
